Five merged PRs since 2026-04-14 added or removed a line containing `restBaseUrl` under `src`. Dates are the main-line commit dates from Falkon, which for squash merges should match the merge dates. I did not open the PR records themselves to confirm.

1. **#661**, "(feat) Migrate stock management to workspace v2", 2026-09-30. Adds a `restBaseUrl` import and a `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/stockmanagement/stockrule\`)` call in `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-rules/add-stock-rules.component.tsx:17-17}` and `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-items/add-stock-item/stock-item-rules/add-stock-rules.component.tsx:164-164}`.
2. **#616**, "(fix) Fix stock report generation, visibility, downloads, and role-based access", 2026-09-02. Rewrites the `restBaseUrl` import in `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-reports/report-list/stock-reports.component.tsx:32-35}`.
3. **#630**, "(fix) Use framework modal for stock locations", 2026-09-21. Removes the `restBaseUrl` import and the `handleMutate(\`${restBaseUrl}/Location?_summary=data\`)` call from `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-locations/stock-locations-table.component.tsx:9-9}`.
4. **#542** (O3-5648), "Wire up stock report submission and add missing patient/stock-item inputs", 2026-05-17. Adds `restBaseUrl` stock item and patient search URLs in `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx:189-189}` and `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-reports/generate-report/create-stock-report.workspace.tsx:224-224}`.
5. **#541** (O3-5647), "Fix User Role Scope Save Functionality", 2026-05-05. Changes the `apiUrl` line in `@file:{openmrs-esm-stock-management-app::src/stock-user-role-scopes/stock-user-role-scopes.resource.ts:57-57}`, which contains `restBaseUrl`.

Checked and excluded: #683, #636 (scoped to its own diff), #605, #567, #553, #552, #562, #622, #528, #514, and the commits `babd91e` and `3c071999`. Each diff showed no `restBaseUrl` line added or removed.

Not fully verified:
- `a5d8db4` (#636) returned a diff too large to inspect. Its title suggests CSS-only changes.
- `79953cf` (#552, the Jest-to-Vitest migration) returned a diff too large to inspect. Test files had no `restBaseUrl` before it, so a change there seems unlikely.
- `babd91e` was not diffed directly. Its title says it removes a dead SCSS rule.
